outputs.explanation: This is a bar/timeline chart showing single measured percentage values for each exposure time condition, not an average across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a micrograph, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel C is a micrograph, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot showing mean±s.e.m. decay curves across power levels; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a series of micrographs, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel F is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve (shaded s.e.m.) and individual data points overlaid, color-coded by cell (n=5).
Panel G is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve (shaded s.e.m.) and individual data points overlaid, color-coded by cell (n=5).
Panel H is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve (shaded s.e.m.) and individual data points overlaid, color-coded by cell (n=5).
Panel I is a set of micrographs, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel J is a line plot showing mean fluorescence intensity with shaded s.e.m. across frames; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
